en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who eats the watercress at night, the vein of leprosy would hit him from his nose, and he would sleep with blood flowing’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one eats watercress during the night the vein of leprosy will hit him from his nose and blood will flow thereof.”’
